Her work

Straight from the room

Meet the owner

Kya Froemke

She finished her training in September 2024 and opened her own room the same year.

Her diploma is from the Euro Institute of Skin Care — a comprehensive course in European skin care, awarded in European Skin Care & Aesthetics. That's the training behind the peels, the microneedling and the facials — and the same house is on the shelf in her room.

Kiki Beauty Co is one room, run by one person. You book with Kya, and Kya is who you get.
